Merger Control & Competition Assessment

Compliance Automation

Automated merger notification validation checking SLC tests, jurisdictional thresholds, and Phase 1/2 procedural compliance against Enterprise Act 2002.

Risk Detection & Early Warning

Detection of merger conditions likely to raise competition concerns via market share concentration, vertical integration, and conglomerate effects analysis.

NLP analysis of merger documentation, remedies proposals, and customer complaint patterns against CMA merger assessment guidelines.

Predictive Analytics

Merger outcome prediction from market definition, HHI concentration, entry barriers, and countervailing buyer power analysis.

Synthesis of market studies, competitor evidence, and economic analysis into merger decision dossiers.

Document Intelligence

Extraction from merger notices, Phase 1 decisions, and remedies monitoring against Enterprise Act timelines.

Stakeholder Reporting

Merger control dashboards showing case throughput, clearance rates, and sector concentration trends.

Real-time Monitoring

Live merger notification tracking, Phase 1/2 timelines, and remedies compliance monitoring.
